settings.pageDescription: Manage your agency, website and communication.

homepage.label: Homepage
homepage.detail: Hero, about and call to action

validation.url: Enter a full link starting with https://
validation.emailListInvalid: “{{value}}” is not a valid email address

livePreview.title: Live preview
livePreview.description: See how the public website renders your content.

parts.yourMetaDescription: Your meta description appears here in search results.

general.title: General
general.description: The core identity of your agency. These details appear across the public website, booking confirmations and search engines.
general.identityDescription: How your agency is named everywhere.
general.agencyNameHint: Shown in emails, the footer and structured data.
general.googleMapsHint: Paste the share link of your office location.

brand.title: Brand identity
brand.description: Your logo, voice and colours — exactly as travellers see them on the public website.
brand.identityDescription: The name and voice of your agency.
brand.agencyNameHint: Inherited from your agency profile — editing it here updates it everywhere.
brand.taglineHint: One short line under your logo.
brand.coloursDescription: Used for buttons, badges and highlights.
brand.websiteUrlHint: Used in emails and structured data.
brand.canonicalUrlHint: Preferred address search engines should index.
brand.livePreviewNote: Updates instantly as you edit. Published to the public website when you save.

homepage.title: Homepage content
homepage.description: Every homepage section is an editable block. Expand a block to edit it, then publish once — no code, no database fields.
homepage.imageHint: Upload directly — no need to paste URLs. Recommended 1920×1080.
homepage.buttonLinkHint: Internal path such as /umrah or a full https link.

hero.name: Hero
hero.help: The first thing visitors see. Keep the headline under 60 characters and use a wide, bright background image.

about.name: About the agency
about.help: A short story about your agency, shown on the homepage and About page.

cta.name: Closing call to action
cta.help: The final nudge before the footer. One clear action performs best.

blocks.generic: Content block rendered on the public website.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: The achievement counters on your homepage. Drag the cards to change the order travellers see them in.
stats.label: Label
stats.tipBody: Keep values short and human — “12 000+” reads better than “12034”. Three to four cards work best on mobile.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: How your website appears in Google and when shared on social media.
seo.searchAppearanceDescription: Title and description for the homepage.
seo.metaDescriptionHint: Under 160 characters. Describe your services and destinations.
seo.keywordsHint: Comma separated. Used for internal search hints.
seo.socialSharingDescription: Image shown on Facebook, WhatsApp and X.
seo.googleVerificationHint: The content value of the google-site-verification tag.
seo.allowIndexing: Allow search engines to index the website
seo.allowIndexingHint: Turn off only while the site is under construction.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: The channels travellers use to reach you. Empty channels are hidden from the public website.
contact.livePreviewDescription: How the contact card renders on the website.
contact.emptyHint: Add at least one contact channel.
contact.contactEmailHint: Published on the website for travellers.

social.title: Social media
social.description: Connect your channels once — they appear in the site footer, contact section and structured data automatically.
social.channelsDescription: Leave a field empty to hide that channel from the website.
social.livePreviewDescription: How the footer social row will look.
social.noChannels: No channels connected yet — the social row stays hidden.

email.title: Email
email.description: Where booking notifications are delivered and how they are labelled.
email.ccRecipientsHint: Optional. Separate several addresses with commas.
email.senderIdentityDescription: How the notification appears in the inbox.
email.replyToHint: Replies from your team go here.
email.livePreviewDescription: Inbox row preview of a new booking email.
email.bookingEmailsToggle: Send an email for every new booking
email.bookingEmailsHint: When off, bookings are still saved and shown in the dashboard.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose which activity creates an alert in the admin dashboard bell.
notifications.newBookingHint: Alerts the team as soon as a traveller reserves a package.
notifications.newMessageHint: Alerts when someone submits the contact form.
notifications.newsletterHint: Useful while growing your mailing list.
notifications.dailyDigestHint: A single summary alert instead of individual pings.
notifications.housekeepingDescription: How long read alerts stay in the bell.

security.title: Security
security.description: Access policies for your dashboard team. Only super admins can change these.
security.teamAccessDescription: Everyone who can sign in to the admin dashboard.
security.require2faHint: Admins must confirm a second factor before reaching the dashboard.
security.auditLogging: Keep an audit log of admin actions
security.auditLoggingHint: Records who changed what, and when.
security.sessionLengthHint: Admins are signed out after this period of inactivity. 1–720.
security.superAdminOnly: Only a super admin can change access policies.

team.title: Team
team.description: Who can sign in to the admin dashboard and what they are allowed to do.
team.membersDescription: Invite colleagues, change roles or revoke access.
team.managedElsewhere: Team access is managed on the Admins page.

branches.translationGroupHint: Shown to French and English speaking travellers. Falls back to Arabic when empty.

blog.pageDescription: Articles shown on the public blog.

gallery.pageDescription: Photos and videos shown on the public gallery.

admins.pageDescription: Grant admin or staff access to your team.
admins.superAdminOnlyDescription: Only super admins can manage admin accounts.
admins.removeAllAccessDescription: {{email}} will lose all admin/staff roles. The auth account is not deleted.
admins.inviteHint: An invitation email will be sent. When the recipient sets a password they'll be able to access the dashboard immediately.
